reviews.body:
Thanks! This matches the TypeScript fix from #1841 (`!line.value.trim()`).

I checked it with 13 tricky inputs, each parsed in one chunk, one character at a time, and split at every position. The final state and errors are identical to `main` except for the #1879 cases, which now parse correctly. `tests/parsers` + `tests/agents` pass (80 tests). Merging for the upcoming release.
